home.emptyTitle: Lessons and practice are on the way

merged.title: Your practice moved to your school login

locked.howTo: Joined the school? Ask the office for your admission number and PIN. They can move your practice to your school login.

errors.network: No internet connection. Your changes are still here; try again when you're back online.
errors.forbidden: You can only do this for classes you teach. Ask an admin if this class should be yours.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again.

home.questionsHint: Write and edit questions for your chapters
home.assessmentsHint: Build tests, quizzes and exams, then publish them
home.gradingHint: Enter and correct grades, with the reason kept
home.overdueHint: Homework past due, and who hasn't handed it in
home.attendanceHint: Mark today's attendance in a few taps, or fix a past day
home.attendanceSummaryHint: Each class's day, and each student's month
home.messagesHint: Send news to a class, one student or the whole school
home.noClassesTeacher: You have no classes this year yet. Ask the admin to assign you one.
home.noClassesAdmin: No classes this year yet. Add one first.
home.cardsHint: Print QR sign-in cards for a class

scope.subject: Subject
scope.noYearStaff: Set the current academic year in the school console (Academic years) first. Everything here belongs to a year.
scope.noYearTeacher: Ask an admin to open this school year. You can add questions and tests once it's set.
scope.noClassesStaff: Add a class in the school console (Classes) first. Assessments belong to a class.
scope.noAssignments: You're not assigned to a class yet
scope.noAssignmentsTeacher: Ask an admin to assign you to your classes for this year.
scope.noSubjects: This class has no subjects yet
scope.noSubjectsStaff: Add its subjects in the school console (Syllabus) first.
scope.noSubjectsTeacher: Ask an admin to set up the syllabus for this class.
scope.noChapters: This subject has no chapters yet
scope.noChaptersStaff: Add its chapters in the school console (Syllabus) first. Questions belong to a chapter.
scope.noChaptersTeacher: Ask an admin to add this subject's chapters. Questions belong to a chapter.

questions.emptyChapter: No questions in this chapter yet
questions.emptyBody: Choose “New question” to write the first one.
questions.pickOne: Pick a question or write a new one
questions.optionsHint: Tap a letter to mark the correct option.
questions.shortHint: Students' answers are matched ignoring capitals and extra spaces.
questions.shortAlsoHint: Other spellings or answers that count as correct, one per line.
questions.marksHint: Whole number from 1 to 100. Leave blank for 1.
questions.readOnlyType: Picture questions for young learners can't be edited here yet. You can still add them to an assessment.
questions.readOnlyInUse: This question is in a published assessment, so it can't change. Make a copy to write a new version.
questions.readOnlyOthers: Another teacher wrote this question. Make a copy if you want your own version.

audio.title: Read-aloud clip
audio.none: No recorded clip yet. Students hear the device voice.
audio.failed: This clip couldn’t play. Check the internet and try again.

assessments.emptyBody: Build one from your question bank, save it as a draft, and publish it when it's ready.
assessments.chapterEmpty: No questions in this chapter. Pick another chapter or “All chapters”.
assessments.noneYet: No questions on the paper yet
assessments.noneYetBody: Tap questions above to add them. You can save a draft without any.
assessments.lockedNote: This assessment is published, so its questions and marks are fixed. You can still change the title, weightage and date.
assessments.publishHint: Publishing shows it to students in the class. Its questions can't change after that.
assessments.closeHint: Closing stops new answers. You can reopen it later.
assessments.savedAsDraft: Saved as a draft, but it couldn't be published. Check it and try Publish again.
assessments.notFoundBody: It may belong to a class you don't teach, or the link is wrong.

files.limits: Images, .md, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel or text. Up to 10 MB.
files.replaceNote: Saving uploads this file in place of the current one. The old file is kept.
files.marksLocked: Fixed once published: grades may already use it.
files.publishHint: Publishing shows the worksheet to students in the class. Choose the file first.

errors.fileEmpty: That file is empty. Choose another one.
errors.fileTooBig: That file is bigger than 10 MB. Make it smaller (e.g. a lower-quality photo) and try again.
errors.fileType: That kind of file can't be used. Choose an image, .md, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel or text file.
errors.pickFailed: Couldn't open the file picker. Please try again.

grading.nothingToGrade: Nothing to grade in this class yet
grading.nothingToGradeBody: Publish a test, homework or worksheet first. Drafts can't be graded.

summary.one: %{count} student · %{graded} graded · %{waiting} waiting to be marked
summary.other: %{count} students · %{graded} graded · %{waiting} waiting to be marked

grading.beforeAttempt: This student hasn't sent an answer for this test yet. If you grade now, their online answers won't be accepted later.

attendance.hint: Everyone starts as present. Tap only the students who are absent, late or on leave.
attendance.pastDay: This day is over. Changing a mark that was already saved needs a reason.
attendance.notTaken: Not taken yet for this day
attendance.waiting: Saved on this device. It will send when you're back online.
attendance.offlineCopy: No connection. This is the class list saved on this device; marks already sent for this day aren't shown.
attendance.reasonHelp: For example: the register shows she was present
attendance.reasonRequired: Write why you're changing a day that is over.
attendance.queued: Saved on this device. It will send once you're online.
attendance.rejectedToast: The school's server didn't take this day. See the note above the list.
attendance.storageFull: This device is out of space, so nothing was saved. Free some space and try again.

rpc.reason_required: this day is over, so a reason is needed. Write one and save again.
rpc.not_authorized: you can only mark attendance for classes you teach.
rpc.date_in_future: you can't mark attendance for a future date.
rpc.enrollment_class_mismatch: a student on this list has moved class. Reload the list and save again.
rpc.enrollment_not_active: a student on this list has left the class. Reload the list and save again.
rpc.other: the server refused it. Reload the list and try again.

attendanceSummary.title: Attendance summary
attendanceSummary.dayEmpty: No classes with students this year
attendanceSummary.dayEmptyBody: Enrol students in a class first. Their attendance shows here once it's taken.
attendanceSummary.schoolTotal: %{taken} of %{classes} classes taken · %{absent} absent · %{late} late · %{leave} on leave
attendanceSummary.rangeEmpty: No students in this class this year
attendanceSummary.rateNote: At school = present + late, out of present + late + absent. Leave isn't counted.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.subtitle: Chapters, topics and concepts: the map every lesson, practice question and follow-up hangs on.
curriculum.subtitleTeacher: Topics and concepts for the subjects you teach this year.
curriculum.navHint: Topics, concepts and prerequisites for each chapter
curriculum.pickChapterBody: Its topics and concepts open here.
curriculum.noChapters: No chapters in this subject yet
curriculum.noChaptersAdmin: Add the first chapter, in textbook order.
curriculum.noChaptersTeacher: Ask the admin to add this subject's chapters first.
curriculum.noTopics: No topics in this chapter yet
curriculum.noTopicsBody: Split the chapter into the topics you teach. Each topic gets a short diagnostic and its own concepts.

tilesLabel.one: Students fill %{count} tile in this topic
tilesLabel.other: Students fill %{count} tiles in this topic

curriculum.noConcepts: No concepts yet. A concept is one idea a student can master, like "adding fractions with the same bottom number".
curriculum.retireTopicHint: Students stop seeing it. Its history stays.
curriculum.readOnly: You can read this chapter. Only its subject's teachers this year and admins can change it.

fields.titleUrHelper: Type it the way you'd say it in class. Leave empty to show the English.
fields.summaryHelper: One or two sentences. Shown above the lesson.
fields.diagnosticHelper: Questions in this topic's first check, %{min} to %{max}. Leave empty for %{def}.
fields.codeHelper: Short and unique, for example PTB-2025.
fields.name: Name
fields.effectiveFromHelper: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-04-01. Optional.

prereqs.title: Prerequisites
prereqs.help: Concepts a student should master before this one. Follow-ups send students back to these.
prereqs.noneEarlier: No earlier class has %{subject} concepts yet.
prereqs.loop: Can't pick: it already needs this concept, so that would make a loop.

curriculum.retiredToast: Retired. Turn on "Show retired" to bring it back.

errors.diagnosticNotNumber: Type a whole number, or leave it empty.
errors.codeRequired: Give the edition a short code.
errors.boardRequired: Name the board, for example Punjab Textbook Board.
errors.dateInvalid: Use a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.cycle: That would make a loop of prerequisites. Nothing was changed.
errors.duplicate: That code is already used by another edition.

editions.heading: Textbook editions
editions.body: Each chapter belongs to one edition (for example the Punjab Textbook Board books in use from April 2025). When the board prints new books, add a new edition and keep the old one for history.
editions.emptyBody: Add the edition your books are from (for example PTB-2025), then attach your chapters to it.
editions.retireHint: A retired edition stays on its chapters but isn't offered for new ones.

attach.heading: Chapters without an edition
attach.body: Chapters made before editions existed. Pick the edition, tick the chapters, attach.
attach.needEdition: Add an edition first, then attach chapters to it.

skipped.one: %{count} already had an edition and was left as it was.
skipped.other: %{count} already had an edition and were left as they were.

curriculum.notReady: The curriculum isn't switched on yet
curriculum.notReadyAdmin: The database update for chapters, topics and concepts (db/017, then db/023) hasn't been run on this project yet. Once it has, this screen fills in by itself.
curriculum.notReadyTeacher: The school hasn't switched on topics and concepts yet. Ask the admin; nothing is lost in the meantime.

importer.title: Import content
importer.subtitle: Drop one topic file: you get a report first, then every good item lands as a draft for review.
importer.navHint: Bring in a topic file: lesson, concepts and questions
importer.notReadyBody: The importer needs the content tables. Ask Hassan to run db/017, db/023 and db/031, then open this again.
importer.useComputerBody: Maths in a file is turned into pictures while it is checked, and that only happens in the browser. Open the console on a Windows PC or a Chromebook to import.
importer.pickChapterBody: The file's topic, concepts and questions go under the chapter you choose here.

drop.title: Drop the topic file here
drop.hint: One JSON file for one topic, as written by the content prompt. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

importer.pickQuestion: Pick a question to see what the checker found.
importer.matchInFile: Same as question %{ref} in this file (%{percent}%)
importer.skipSimilarDetail: %{count} questions look close to one already in the bank
importer.byPersonDetail: Leave this off for a file from the AI content prompt
importer.notePlaceholder: e.g. Class 9 Maths, chapter 2, first run
importer.willImport: %{questions} questions and %{lessons} lesson blocks will be saved as drafts.
importer.nothingToImport: Nothing left to import from this file.
importer.doneNext: Nothing is approved yet: a teacher checks each item in the review queue before students see it.
importer.noBatchesBody: Your imports show up here, so a bad one can be pulled back as a whole.
importer.retireBody: Its %{count} questions and its lesson stop being offered. Nothing is deleted, and papers that already used a question keep it.

errors.network: No internet connection. Nothing was saved; try again when you're back online.
errors.forbidden: You can only import into classes you teach. Ask an admin if this class should be yours.
errors.notConfigured: This app build has no backend set up.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again.
errors.retired: That batch was retired, so nothing more can be added to it.
errors.mismatch: The file doesn't match the chapter you picked. Start again and check the chapter.
errors.reason: Say why you are retiring the batch, in a few words.
errors.notJson: That file isn't JSON. Export the topic again from the content prompt.
errors.readFile: The file could not be read. Try choosing it again.
errors.noMath: Maths in this file could not be turned into pictures, so those questions are left out. Reload the page and try again.

issues.tooLarge: The file is bigger than %{detail} MB.
issues.tooManyQuestions: More than %{detail} questions in one file: split it by concept.
issues.wrongType: Not the right kind of value.
issues.badValue: Not a value the app can use.
issues.fieldIgnored: Not used by the app, so it was ignored.
issues.requiresUnknown: Needs %{detail}, which isn't in this file. Link it by hand in Curriculum.
issues.requiresLoop: The concepts need each other in a circle (%{detail}).
issues.conceptUnused: No question for concept %{detail}, so it gets no diagnostic.
issues.typeUnsupported: The app can't import questions of type %{detail}.
issues.correctMissing: The correct option isn't one of the options.
issues.correctNotSingle: Exactly one option must be correct.
issues.answerInvalid: The answer doesn't fit this question type.
issues.whyWrongUnknown: An explanation for option %{detail}, which doesn't exist.
issues.explanationMissing: No explanation, so students see no feedback.
issues.urMissing: No Urdu yet: a teacher adds it in review.
issues.duplicateInFile: The same question as number %{detail} in this file.
issues.similarInFile: Very close to question %{detail} in this file.
issues.similarInBank: Very close to a question already in the bank.
issues.mathUnbalanced: A $ sign with no closing $: the maths may be wrong.
issues.mathError: This maths could not be drawn: %{detail}
issues.blockTypeUnknown: %{detail} isn't a lesson block the app can show.
issues.lessonConceptUnknown: Points at concept %{detail}, which isn't in this file.
issues.altMissing: A picture needs a description in both languages.
issues.captionMissing: Every step needs a caption in both languages.
issues.svgUnsafe: The picture holds something that isn't allowed (%{detail}).
issues.svgTooBig: The picture is %{detail} KB: too big for a cheap Chromebook.
issues.svgTooManyElements: The picture has %{detail} parts: too many to draw smoothly.
issues.imageOrSvg: Give either a drawing or a photo, not both.
issues.sceneLayerMissing: The picture has no part named %{detail}.
issues.sceneLayerUnknown: A step moves %{detail}, which isn't listed as a moving part.
issues.sceneTooManyLayers: %{detail} moving parts: more than the app animates at once.
issues.stepTooLong: A step may last up to 4 seconds (found %{detail}).
issues.widgetUnknown: %{detail} isn't one of the app's interactive widgets.
issues.chartKind: %{detail} isn't a chart the app draws.
issues.chartSeriesLength: The chart has %{detail} values where it needs one per x value.
issues.hotspotRange: A tap point must sit inside the picture (0 to 1).
issues.transcriptMissing: No transcript, so the video is lost offline.
issues.notExamSafe: %{detail} can't be used on an exam question: only still pictures and charts.
issues.lessonExists: This topic already has a lesson, so this one was left out.

importer.addsToTopic: This topic is already there: %{concepts} of its concepts are reused, and %{lessons} lessons it already has are left out.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.subtitle: Preview every lesson as students will see it, then approve it, send it back or retire it.
lessons.notReadyBody: Run db/017, db/023 and db/031 on this project first (see db/README.md).
lessons.none: No lessons in this subject yet
lessons.noneBody: Import a topic file with a lesson in it; it arrives here as a draft.
lessons.sendBackBody: Say what needs to change. Students stop seeing it until it is approved again.
lessons.retireBody: Students stop seeing it. Nothing is deleted, and the history stays.
lessons.goneBody: It may belong to a subject you don't teach.

done.approve: Approved. Students can read it now.

errors.stale: Someone changed this lesson. It has been reloaded: look again before deciding.
errors.notReady: Lesson approval isn't switched on yet: run db/033 on this project.
errors.forbidden: Only a teacher of this subject (or an admin) can decide on this lesson.

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: One question at a time, both languages side by side. Approve it for where it can be used, fix it, or send it back.
review.navHint: Approve, fix or send back imported questions
review.notReadyBody: The review queue needs the content tables. Ask Hassan to run db/017, db/023, db/031 and db/032, then open this again.

bulk.title: Approve %{n} questions?
bulk.body: They'll be approved for: %{scopes}. You haven't opened each one, so only do this for questions you've already checked.
bulk.skipped: %{n} skipped (not yours, no concept, or changed meanwhile).

pane.pickOneBody: Choose one from the list, or press J to start at the top.
pane.noConcept: No concept yet. Only an admin can tag it; until then nobody can approve it.
pane.noConceptStaff: No concept yet. Edit it and pick one before approving.
pane.notYours: You can read this question, but deciding on it is for teachers of its subject.
pane.inUse: It's on a published paper, so it can't be edited here (old papers read it as it is).
pane.scopesHint: Keys 1 to 4. Exam is never ticked for you.

blocked.noScopes: Tick at least one place it can be used.

reason.bodyReject: It's kept (never deleted) but won't be used. Say why, so whoever imports the next file can do better.
reason.bodyChanges: It goes to “Changes asked” with your note. Anyone who teaches it can fix it and approve it.
reason.label: Why
reason.placeholderReject: e.g. the answer is wrong; duplicate of another question
reason.placeholderChanges: e.g. option C's Urdu is a word-for-word translation

editor.title: Edit question
editor.note: Saving makes a new version. Any approval is dropped, so approve it again afterwards.
editor.noConcepts: This chapter has no concepts yet. Add one in Curriculum first.
editor.notEditable: This kind of question is edited in the question bank.

errors.stemRequired: Write the question in at least one language.
errors.numericInvalid: The answer must be a number.
errors.notEditable: This kind of question is edited in the question bank.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.body: On a computer the whole queue works from the keyboard. Shortcuts pause while you type in a box.

rows.approve: A: approve for the ticked places
rows.checks: V: answer is right · U: Urdu reads naturally
rows.save: Ctrl + Enter: save an edit · Esc: close

empty.changesBody: Questions you ask changes for wait here.
empty.retiredBody: Rejected questions are kept here, never deleted.
empty.allDoneBody: You reviewed %{n} this time. Pick another topic, or import the next file.

errors.stale: Someone changed this question a moment ago. It's reloaded: check it again.
errors.inUse: It's on a published paper, so it can't be edited here.
errors.badConcept: That concept isn't in this chapter, or isn't yours.
errors.scopes: Tick at least one place it can be used.

stuck.title: Who's stuck
stuck.subtitle: Open follow-ups by idea. Let a student move on, or open one again, with a reason.
stuck.navHint: Follow-ups by idea, and who has tried the most
stuck.notReadyBody: They appear after migrations 019 and 034 run on this project.
stuck.emptyBody: No open follow-ups in this class right now.
stuck.relaxBody: The follow-up closes and the idea comes back later in revision. Your name and reason are saved.
stuck.restoreBody: The follow-up opens again with a fresh start. Your name and reason are saved.

errors.notYours: Only this subject's teacher (or the office) can change this.
errors.state: This changed meanwhile. Pull to refresh.
errors.alreadyOpen: This student already has an open follow-up on this idea.
errors.network: No internet. Try again when you're online.

quick.title: Quick create
quick.subtitle: Pick a class and subject, check the plan, publish. Questions are drawn at random from those approved for exams.

borrowed.one: 1 question came from another difficulty to make up the count.
borrowed.other: %{count} questions came from another difficulty to make up the count.

short.one: 1 question short: only %{got} fit this plan. Add chapters, approve more questions, or publish with fewer.
short.other: %{count} questions short: only %{got} fit this plan. Add chapters, approve more questions, or publish with fewer.

quick.savedAsDraft: Saved as a draft. Check it and publish from here.
quick.noSubjects: No subjects in this class yet. Add one in Curriculum first.
quick.notReadyBody: Generated tests need the exam update (db/020) on this project.
quick.noneApproved: No questions approved for exams here yet
quick.noneApprovedBody: Approve questions with the Exam scope in the review queue, then come back.

errors.network: No connection. Nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You can't create tests for this class.
errors.notConfigured: The app isn't connected to a database.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was published.

quick.noSwap: No other approved question in this topic to swap in.
quick.liveBody: Start it in class now: students join with a code and the server keeps the time. Leave minutes blank to use the plan's.
quick.readOut: Read this code out to the class
quick.readOutBody: Students open Tests and type the code, or tap the exam if it's already listed.

ended.one: Exam ended. 1 open paper was handed in.
ended.other: Exam ended. %{count} open papers were handed in.

quick.minutesInvalid: Minutes must be a whole number from 1 to 600.

launchErrors.notYours: Only this subject's teacher can start it.
launchErrors.closed: This one is closed. Reopen it or make a new one.

quick.offlineTitle: Or let them do it offline
quick.offlineBody: Students save the paper while online (no answers in it) and do it any time in the window, even without internet. Lower integrity: the device keeps the time.

offlineOpenBody.one: Open until %{date}. %{count} minute once a student starts.
offlineOpenBody.other: Open until %{date}. %{count} minutes once a student starts.

offlineErrors.notYours: You don't teach this class and subject.
offlineErrors.started: Students have already started this exam.
offlineErrors.live: It's running live now. End it first.
offlineErrors.window: Pick a window that ends in the future (31 days at most).

examLive.voidHint: Void a paper to leave it out of grades, for example when a student will resit.
examLive.voidBody: It won't be graded or counted in item analysis. Say why: it's kept with the paper.
examLive.noStudentsBody: Enrol students in this class to see them here.
examLive.notReadyBody: The live view needs the exam results update (db/035) on this project.
examLive.noPapersBody: Results show here as students hand in.
examLive.notInGrades: Not in grades yet. Check the papers, then confirm.

waitOpen.one: 1 student is still writing. Confirm once everyone has handed in.
waitOpen.other: %{count} students are still writing. Confirm once everyone has handed in.

confirmBody.one: 1 score goes into grades, with "Exam result" in the grade history.
confirmBody.other: %{count} scores go into grades, with "Exam result" in the grade history.

examLive.confirmFollowUps: Students who were weak on an idea get a follow-up for it. This happens once: after confirming, papers can't be voided.

endBody.one: 1 student is still writing. Their paper is handed in as it is.
endBody.other: %{count} students are still writing. Their papers are handed in as they are.

examLive.fewPapers: Fewer than 5 papers: the easy, hard and trap labels show from 5.

trapNote.one: %{option} pulled 1 student. Worth going over why.
trapNote.other: %{option} pulled %{count} students. Worth going over why.

errors.stillRunning: Someone is still writing. End the exam or wait.
errors.network: No connection. Nothing changed. Try again.

offline.acceptBody: These answers came in after the window or over the time, so they weren't marked. Accepting marks them and counts the score. Say why.
